boardTitle: B168: the recipe's PD card as on the Plate, one portion first, - and + up to the whole recipe
title: The numbers under One portion show the whole recipe

opportunity.from: Seen while drawing B166, 23 November 2026, on Lazy Burek's page; Coach Milan 24 November 07:04: yes, its own ticket, we need to fix that.
opportunity.job: Read what one portion of my recipe holds.
opportunity.kind: Says something not true: the table under One portion shows the whole recipe.
opportunity.why_now: B166 made the table readable, so its numbers are now read.

problem: On a recipe that makes 4 portions, the PD card says One portion, 549 kcal and 224 g. Its numbers say Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal, fat 135 g: the whole recipe. The Nutrition table below says 1 portion, 224 g. Two places on one page disagree about one portion.
story: When I read the numbers of a recipe, I want to see one portion first and step up to the whole recipe, in the same card I know from the Plate, so that I can trust what I plan, eat and cook.
now: The recipe page's PD card has its own layout: one small line, 549 kcal · 23.3 g protein · 224 g, and its numbers open inside the card. The numbers are handed the whole recipe. The Plate's card has Energy, Weight and Protein as rows and opens its numbers under the card.
proposed: 1. The recipe page takes the Plate's PD card, one component for both (PdCard): PD with its tap to the scale, the words against your target, Energy, Weight and Protein as rows, the letters; the numbers open under the card, not inside it. 2. In the card's title, − and +: One portion first, then 2 portions, up to All 4 portions. Energy, Weight, Protein and the numbers follow; PD and the letters stay, they are rates. A recipe of one portion says All of it, with no − and +. 3. The design rules get the card as a rule (docs/rules/design.md D8: every PD card is PdCard; its numbers open under it), and design-rules.cjs checks it.
looked_at: B: the card follows Cook it's − 4 portions +: not chosen (Coach Milan 07:48: A); the card would start at the whole recipe. A switch in the table: not chosen; the − and + in the title say what is counted. A food's PD card (FoodCard) has the same table inside its card: not in B168, a ticket of its own unless Coach Milan says.
short: The recipe's PD card is the Plate's card, PdCard; one portion first, − and + up to the whole recipe; release 0.3.193

ac.title: One portion first
ac.text: Given Lazy Burek, 4 portions, when I open its page, then the PD card says One portion, Energy 549 kcal, Weight 224 g, Protein 23 g, as rows

ac.title: The numbers under the card
ac.text: Given that card, when I tap the letters, then the numbers open under the card and say Total 224 g and 549 kcal

ac.title: Up to the whole recipe
ac.text: Given One portion, when I tap + three times, then the title says All 4 portions, the rows say 2,194 kcal, 897 g and 93 g, and the numbers Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal; + is off

ac.title: Rates stay
ac.text: Given All 4 portions, when I read PD and the letters, then they say 4.3 and F+ c- fi- p, as for one portion

ac.title: Back down
ac.text: Given All 4 portions, when I tap − three times, then the card says One portion again and − is off

ac.title: A recipe of one portion
ac.text: Given a recipe that makes 1 portion, when I open its page, then the card says All of it, with no − and +

ac.title: One card
ac.text: Given the Plate and a recipe page, when I compare their PD cards, then both are PdCard: the same rows, the scale on a tap of PD, the numbers under the card

unchanged: The Plate's PD card looks and works as now: it becomes PdCard, nothing on it changes.
The letters, F+ c- fi- p: per 100 kcal.
The Nutrition table: 1 portion, All 4 and 100 g, as now.
Cook it's − 4 portions + cooks what it says, as now.
The colours of the table, as B166.
checks: Middle: the PD card on Recipes and the Plate (one component now), new words. The unit tests, the build, a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC7, and the walkthroughs that open a recipe's numbers or the Plate's card: chip-lines, fibre, pd-scale, recipe-changed, steps-and-parts, plate-landing, make-meal, design-rules, and the German sweep. About 15 minutes.
details: src/components/PdCard.tsx: title, pd, pdRef, fit, line, kcal, grams, protein, letters. The Plate (JourneyScreen readout) and NutritionCard (the recipe page, an imported recipe's page) use it. The numbers table is drawn by the caller under the card.
The portions: a count from 1 to the recipe's portions, 1 when the page opens; the foods at their grams times count divided by portions go to the rows and the numbers.
New words: nutrition.fewerPortions, nutrition.morePortions (the buttons' names), nutrition.nPortions (2 portions), nutrition.allPortions (All 4 portions); Srpski confirmed by Claude, German in Beta.
docs/rules/design.md D8; design-rules.cjs: every PD card on the Plate and a recipe page has .rd-rows, and no .nt inside a .readout.
The pictures: before from main, 0.3.192; new from one scratch build of main with PdCard and the portions, not committed.
